pad_definition: Locked-page offset b in S = m·(D/100) + offset. residual + pad = actual S − m·(D/100).

gov_2018.reason: A full 2018 surplus-line fit was not computed. Party-registration by county for 2018 is not among the raw files on this computer, and the Kansas SOS site returns HTTP 403 to this computer. The 2018 Governor precinct workbook is on hand, but the Wyandotte tab is a placeholder directing the reader to contact the SOS, so even the vote file is incomplete for all 105 counties.

notes.year_2026: unofficial until December 1, 2026 certification; SOS update 11/08/2026
notes.denominator: race total votes, never ballots cast
notes.registration: actual Kansas SOS Democratic registration share
notes.cvr: Cast vote record (CVR) access may be blocked; this analysis does not use CVRs.
notes.removal_primary: transfer: move I votes from Democrat to Republican; race total unchanged
notes.removal_secondary: subtract-only: remove I from Democratic votes and from the race total
